semanticRigPlan.modelContract: Independent direct EntityModel<NaamahModel.State> with complete owned geometry, UV layout, and animation; no shared Warlockery rig or geometry helper.

behaviorDrivenAnimation.intent: Near-still sovereign posture with slow opposing drift in side locks, sleeve shells, and rear tidal mantle.
Measured glide-step led by the crown and bodice; skirt layers and hair lag behind independently without collapsing into player gait.
Both arms open into a broad circular sweep while bell sleeves and rear mantle fan outward as the main readable wave telegraph.
Body compresses into a narrow vertical silhouette before snapping into a re-opened sovereign stance.
One controlled downward command gesture; tentacles remain environmental floor effects and never become model anatomy.
One hand raised and one lowered, crown, hair, sleeves, and tidal mantle lifting in an upward water-column silhouette.
Chest and throat jewels pulse together while the face holds the challenger; motion quiets immediately when line of sight breaks.
Weaponless close-range palm or sleeve-backed strike that preserves regal posture.
